name: Marketplace Qualification
description: Child table backing Marketplace Profile.qualifications. Mirrors the 'title'/'issuer'/'year' keys in each accountant's qualifications array (class-dummy-data-provider.php) and the credential cards rendered in accountant-profile.php. The 'code' key that used to exist there was removed from the UI, so it is intentionally not modeled here.

fields.label: Year
fields.description: Kept as Data (not Int) to match existing values like '2010' rendered as plain text, and to allow ranges if needed later.
